items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: I read an article recently about John Hammond, who I never knew was related to the Vanderbilts

ctx.x: Yeah. It's a little less special.

Big time. Big time. And then it seems like one of the great things about the old record labels was they were really looking for — like I read an article recently about John Hammond, who I never knew was related to the Vanderbilts you know. I mean I had known his son, who was a great guitar player John Hammond Jr. In the '60s I met him. But I mean John Hammond, if you list the names of the people that he found and that recorded, they were all brilliant. They were so talented. It doesn't seem like you could make a…
I'm going to quote you on that. That's a good one.
